headline: Chilean Metalworking Industry Output Drops 5.8% Year-to-Date
summary: Chilean metalworking association Asimet reported nine consecutive months of output declines, resulting in a 5.8% contraction in 2026.
why: Industrial equipment manufacturing trends provide insight into capital expenditure in mining and infrastructure.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: Domestic industrial metalworking production recorded a sustained 5.8% year-to-date decline.
